fieldValues.title: Images
fieldValues.summary: An image goes in its own paragraph. Open a paragraph's menu and choose **Add image below**, then pick or drop a PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG of up to 1 MB. **Alt text** is required: it says what the image shows, for someone who can't see it. **Copy as HTML** takes the images with it. A **caption** is optional and shows under the image. Choose **Full width** to fill the column, or **Original size** to keep the image's own size, placed left, centre or right. Text never wraps around an image. To change one, open its menu and choose **Edit image…**: there you can replace the file or remove it, and Ctrl+Z undoes either. An SVG that contains a script or links to another file is refused, because it could run code or track readers: export it again as a plain SVG. A markdown image (`![](…)`) typed into an ordinary paragraph doesn't show: use an image paragraph instead.
